description: Returns one value of one indicator for up to 20 countries or regions: for the given year, or the latest observed value in each country when no year is given. Each value has its own period and chart link; projections are labelled. Codes without data are listed separately.

countries.description: ISO3 codes of the countries or regions to compare.

items.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code, for example USA, DEU, ARG, or WLD for the world.

countries.title: Countries

indicator.description: Indicator slug from search_indicators, for example cpi-inflation.
indicator.title: Indicator

year.description: Calendar year. Omit for the latest observed value.
year.title: Year

name: compare_countries
title: Compare countries
